kitDescription: Noir is a Wind shotgun Attacker on Burst III who plays as a team-wide attack and ammo battery rather than a pure nuker. Her first skill is a permanent team aura that adds a flat 14.08% of her own ATK to every ally, active from the start of the fight as long as she is above 70% HP (never an issue at scope lock). Every time the team enters Full Burst, she hands all allies +5 rounds of magazine capacity for 10 seconds and instantly tops up 39.88% of each ally's magazine, which is real damage because it means more shots fired and less reload downtime. Her own burst hits the boss for 351.64% of final ATK, then buffs Hit Rate and Interruption-Part damage for shotgun allies (13.93% / 23.23%, 10s). If one of her Rabbit-squad teammates (Blanc or Rouge) is on the field, she additionally gives the whole team a longer 30-second Hit Rate ▲11.61% and Interruption-Part ▲19.36% package.

skill1.explanation: Both blinds and the driver converge on casterAtkPct/passive/allies. Driver N1 pins value ≈ 0.1408×noir.staticAtk, identical across all 4 allies, expiresFrame null; S5 independently confirmed it is live before the first shot and moves EVERY ally's damage. Nearest-wrong (atkPct) is discriminated by a counterfactual run.

verdictRationale: GO. Convergence is GREEN and mechanical: the S5 blind test suite, written from prose alone, runs 19 PASSED / 3 SKIPPED / 0 FAILED against the driver's SHIPPED override, and the S6 blind override is block-for-block identical on every stat, value, trigger, target and duration. The only two diffs are non-findings: (1) the blind's noFb:true + crit:true on the 351.64% flatDamage are behaviourally redundant — the driver's N4 MEASURED fbMajorApplied false on every nuke instance without noFb, matching the SSOT's burst-cast timing rule, and function-type damage crits at the caster's rate by default; (2) the blind's teamHas.slugs:[] is a self-flagged blind data gap (no access to characters.json squad fields) whose stated recipe the driver executed to reach [blanc, rouge], owner-ruled 2026-07-20. Zero REAL-GOTCHAs: no kit line is silently dropped (both `unmodeled` arrays are empty because every line is a block), and the two condition clauses that are not encoded (>70% HP; 'still on the battlefield') are trivially satisfied at scope lock and documented in the note. Discrimination is met on all eight load-bearing lines, each against the S2b reviewer's named nearest-wrong: casterAtkPct-vs-atkPct, fullBurstEnter-vs-burstCast (pinned at FRAME level — grant at FB-entry frame 400 vs cast frame 378, the counterfactual landing on 378), allies-vs-self, alliesOfWeapon-SG-vs-allies (driver's COMP A carries 2 SG + 2 non-SG allies, discriminating by target SET rather than cardinality — stronger than the blind's noir-alone fixture), gated-vs-ungated proven in BOTH directions across two comps, and partsDamagePct-vs-attackDamagePct excluded by an exact byte-identical-totals inertness pin. Fire-rate check passes on every block: S1 is live before the first shot, S2 fires on every FB entry (fbStarts×4 applies), the nuke fires once per cast, the SG package rides only noir's own casts, and the gated package is proven to fire in COMP B rather than merely being present. Residuals the owner should spot-check (same-model, none blocking): (a) all three agents are the same model family except S2b (claude-fable-5, which independently returned GO with the same eight FAITHFUL dispositions) — the strongest cross-family corroboration here is that the S2b reviewer's nearest-wrong list maps 1:1 onto the driver's counterfactuals; (b) the S2 same-frame ORDERING — the 39.88% refill resolving against the RAISED 14-round cap rather than base 9 — is documented in the override note but not behaviourally pinned, because the engine's ammo snap emits no event (sim.ts:2105); it is a real shots-fired quantity and worth a future pin if an ammo-counter observable is added; (c) the hitRatePct→core-lift MAGNITUDE is engine-side and measurement-gated (⚑3), out of scope per the magnitude rule — these tests pin the buff's presence, target and duration only. Nothing must change for GO.
